model: REIT AFFO capitalisation at cost of equity (engine route)

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: terminal growth = contractual rent escalators (97% of leases, ~3%/yr) net of the recurring-capex drag; none of the historical CAGRs is a usable forward proxy at a cyclical trough
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR is -5.6% (FY2022 $22,674M -> FY2025 $19,098M) against revenue +5.4%: FY2025 carried $1.43B of GAAP losses from real-estate impairments and the dividend exceeded GAAP earnings. GAAP EPS CAGRs are omitted as meaningless (FY2025 -$8.44, Q3-2026 -$3.74 on impairments). FFO as adjusted per share compounded +2.3% FY2022-FY2025 ($8.42 -> $9.01) and then fell to $6.40E in FY2026 (-29%) -- the FY2022-26E CAGR of -6.6% is the downturn, not a trend.
historical_growth.notes: Revenue: FY2022 $2,589M -> FY2025 $3,027M (3yr); FY2020 $1,886M -> FY2025 (5yr). FFO as adjusted ($M): FY2022 1,361.7 -> FY2025 1,534.7 = +4.1% (3yr); the kpis series starts FY2022 so no 5yr figure. The FFO series is used in place of owner FCF for the CAGR because that is the flow this model capitalises; reported OCF-minus-construction FCF is structurally negative for a developer-REIT and is not a growth series.

scenario_narratives.base: Reset-then-recover. 2027 is a second down year: same-property NOI stays negative (management's own early look), 1.4M RSF of key expirations create downtime, the $720M of dispositions pulled forward from 2027 and continued recycling shrink the rent roll, and expensed interest rises as the hybrid notes season and capitalised interest falls with the 1.9M RSF pipeline. FFO as adjusted bottoms near $5.6/sh in 2027 (vs $6.40 FY2026 and a ~$5.64 Q4-2026 annualised exit), then recovers as 2025-26 expiration downtime anniversaries, signed-not-commenced leases (90.8% vs 87.1% occupied) start paying, the 77%-leased development pipeline stabilises through 2028 and biotech funding normalises gradually. Occupancy reaches ~93% by 2031 (below the ~95% ten-year average), FFO/sh ~$7.1 in 2031 and ~$8.5 by 2036 -- still under the FY2024 peak of $9.47 because the asset base is ~20% smaller after dispositions and interest is structurally higher. Recurring capex stays heavy through 2029 while vacancy is re-leased, then settles at ~12% of revenue including straight-line rent. AFFO covers the $2.88 dividend only thinly in 2027-28 (~1.0x) and comfortably from 2030.
scenario_narratives.bull: Biotech funding and IPO windows reopen in 2027, rate cuts lower both the cost of capital and competing yields, and the Megacampus concentration strategy (80% of rent, ~19-point occupancy premium to the three largest markets) absorbs demand first. Same-property NOI turns positive in 2028, occupancy regains 92% by 2029 and 94-95% by 2031, re-leasing spreads return to positive, the disposition program completes at 7-7.5% cap rates and S&P's outlook returns to stable. FFO as adjusted/sh ~$5.8 in 2027, $6.4 in 2028, ~$8.3 by 2031 and ~$10 by 2036 on 47% margins; recurring capex falls back to ~10% of revenue plus straight-line rent. Gordon value at 10%/3% (14.3x AFFO) binds below the 16x cap.
scenario_narratives.bear: Prolonged oversupply. Lab vacancy in Boston, the Bay Area and San Diego stays near 30% into 2028, venture funding does not recover, additional tenant wind-downs ($30M+ of FFO in 2027, as management flags) and negative cash re-leasing spreads (guided -15% to -7% for 2026) push occupancy to ~84-85% in 2027-28. Dispositions clear only at wider cap rates, S&P downgrades to BBB, refinancing of the 2027-29 maturities ($350M Jan-27, $425M Jan-28, $700M 2029) is at higher coupons, and a second dividend reset becomes plausible as AFFO falls below the $2.88 payout. FFO as adjusted/sh ~$5.2 in 2027 and ~$4.9 in 2028-29 before a slow drift up to ~$6.1 by 2036 on a 39% margin; recurring capex stays at 14%+ of revenue because vacancy is being re-leased continuously. Terminal growth 2% and a 13x cap reflect a landlord that never regains pricing power in this scenario.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Capitalise the cash earnings a REIT actually distributes -- FFO as adjusted less recurring capex and straight-line rent -- at a USD cost of equity, with the balance sheet already inside the flow (net debt zero in the bridge). Do not extrapolate the FY2026 trough ($6.40 FFO/sh, 87.1% occupancy, -6.7% same-store NOI) in either direction: the base starts BELOW it in 2027 and recovers toward, but not back to, the 2024 peak. Development spending is not charged and its NOI is not fully credited; growth paths are net of the disposition program. The spread between the 10% cost-of-equity value and the 15% hurdle entry price is the price of waiting for the cycle to turn.
key_risks_to_valuation: Cost of equity: at 10% with 2.5% terminal growth the base is ~13x terminal AFFO; +/-50bp on the 10Y Treasury moves the base value roughly +/-8% (see sensitivity grid). The 10Y was 4.86% on 2026-11-06, down ~40bp from the October REIT builds.
Mid-cycle margin: the 45% terminal FFO margin assumes ~93% occupancy and ~69% Adjusted EBITDA margin. Each 1pt of terminal margin is ~$2.5/sh of base value.
Recurring capex intensity: if re-leasing TI/LC settles at 14% of revenue rather than 12% (the bear path), base value falls ~$5/sh; ARE's 2026 spend of $510M is nearly double 2024's $273M.

Disposition execution: the growth paths assume ~$1.9B of 2026 sales close at or near book after the $637.9M Q3 impairment; further impairments do not hit FFO but signal lower private-market values and weaker refinancing capacity.
Dividend coverage: 2027-28 base AFFO (~$3.0/sh) barely covers the $2.88 dividend; a second cut would not change intrinsic value but would likely reset the market multiple.

Development pipeline treated as self-funding: if the 1.9M RSF under construction (77% leased/negotiating) stabilises below pro-forma yields, the implicit offset between development NOI and disposition dilution breaks in the wrong direction.
FY0 is an estimate: Q4-2026 revenue and FFO are implied from the 26-Oct-2026 guidance midpoint; the FY2026 10-K (Feb-2027) should replace them on the next update.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (regular close); 52-week range 38.34-59.76
data_sources.financials: research/ARE/Reports/ARE_Metrics.csv (SEC XBRL via metrics_normalized, 101 periods) and the ARE.duckdb kpis table (FFOAsAdjusted, FFOAsAdjustedPerShare, Occupancy, SameStoreNOIGrowth/Cash, RentalRateChange/Cash, LeasingVolumeRSF, UnderConstructionRSF, AdjEBITDAMargin, InvestmentGradeTenantPct, WALTYears); 10-Q Q3-2026 (research/ARE/Extracted/ARE_Quarterly_Q3-2026.txt) for guidance, capex, interest, leverage targets, share count and debt; 10-K FY2025 for 2024-25 capex, capitalised interest and disposition cap rates
data_sources.qualitative: research/ARE/Reports/ARE_Analysis.json (2026-11-08); 10-Q Q3-2026 'Summary of key items that may impact 2026 and 2027 results'

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026E total revenue: 9M-2026 actual $2,005.0M (Q1 671.0 + Q2 662.8 + Q3 671.2, metrics_normalized) plus Q4-2026E ~$640M after the ~$1.9B midpoint disposition program (weighted-average completion November 2026, 10-Q Q3-2026 line 699) takes effect.
inputs.share_count_basis: Company FFO-per-share denominator, Q3-2026: FFO as adjusted $264.4M / $1.54 = 171.7M (weighted-average diluted 170.751M plus unvested RSAs participating in FFO). Held FLAT: SBC is expensed inside FFO as adjusted and charged once via sbc_pct_path; no forward equity sales agreements outstanding at 30-Sep-2026 (10-Q line 5096), ATM unused in 2026, and management states no equity issuance is in the 2026 funding plan.

debt_memo.why_zero: AFFO is a post-interest, post-NCI flow capitalised at the cost of equity; deducting net debt again would charge the debt twice (dcf-methods SKILL.md non-FCF rule). Real balance sheet recorded here for the reader and for the sanity check.
debt_memo.total_debt_components: Unsecured senior notes $10,820.7M + junior subordinated (hybrid) notes $985.1M (issued Aug-2026, initial 7.25%) + unsecured line of credit / commercial paper (balance of metrics_normalized total_debt 12,897.0); secured notes nil
debt_memo.net_debt_and_preferred_to_adj_ebitda: 6.9x Q3-2026 annualised (6.6x adjusted for pending items); Q4-2026 annualised target 5.6x-6.2x (10-Q line 9352)
debt_memo.credit_rating: S&P BBB+, outlook revised to negative in 2026
debt_memo.interest_expense_2026_guidance_musd: 260-300 (near high end); gross interest ~$520M less capitalised ~$240M. Capitalised interest falls as the pipeline shrinks (5.5M RSF under construction FY2023 -> 1.9M RSF Q3-2026), so expensed interest rises structurally even as debt is repaid from dispositions

inputs.fcf_basis_note: last_fcf is FY2026E house AFFO: FFO as adjusted $1,097M (guidance midpoint $6.40 x 171.7M; 9M actual $856.4M + Q4E ~$241M) less AFFO adjustments of ~$565M (revenue- and non-revenue-enhancing capex $510M guidance midpoint, 10-Q line 9193, plus straight-line rent revenue ~$55M midpoint of $40-70M, line 9454). reported_fcf is the same figure with SBC treated as non-cash (street basis): 532 + 40 = 572. FFO as adjusted is already attributable to common stockholders (net of NCI) and already after interest and SBC expense.
inputs.sbc_source: Cash-flow-statement SBC add-back (SEC XBRL ShareBasedCompensation, metrics_normalized): FY2025 $94.7M, Q1-2026 $11.0M, H1-2026 $21.2M; FY2026E ~$40M assuming Q3/Q4 at the H1 run-rate (grants cut and forfeitures from the 2026 headcount/comp reset). Equity-award tax withholding is not separately disclosed; SBC is an expense inside FFO as adjusted (REIT FFO does not add it back), so the house flow deducts it exactly once.
inputs.buyback_note: No repurchases in 9M-2026 (kpis buybacks 9M-2026 = 0). FY2025 $208.2M and FY2024 $50.1M were repurchased before the dividend cut; the flat count is a modelling convention the company is not currently funding.
inputs.fy0_basis: estimate: 9M-2026 actuals plus Q4-2026 implied by the 26-Oct-2026 guidance midpoint
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-11-06T21:00:03Z regular close (Friday); valuation written Sunday 2026-11-08, no after-hours print
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of equity 10.0% in USD: 10Y UST 4.86% (Yahoo ^TNX, 2026-11-06) + ~5.1% equity premium (beta ~1.0-1.1 x 5.0% ERP). Above the house REIT builds for O (9.5%) and MAA (9.0%) because ARE is a single-sector cyclical landlord with a BBB+/negative rating, a 45% dividend cut and $1.0B of 7.25% hybrid capital; below an operating-company WACC because 97% of leases carry contractual escalators, WALT is 7.7 years and 57% of rent is investment-grade/large-cap. The SAME rate is used in all three scenarios -- cyclicality, oversupply and tenant-credit risk are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked into the discount rate (owner-fcf-adaptations (f)).
inputs.lease_treatment: Not applicable: ARE is the lessor. Its own ground-lease obligations are expensed inside NOI/FFO, so they are already in the flow; no lease liability is added to debt (debt is zero in the bridge by construction).
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, in the flows: FFO as adjusted is 'attributable to Alexandria Real Estate Equities, Inc.'s common stockholders' (net of consolidated JV partners' share, ~$109M of 9M-2026 net income attributable to NCI). No NCI deduction in the bridge. Redeemable NCI $9.1M is immaterial.
inputs.notes: MODEL: REIT AFFO capitalisation at cost of equity, run through the Drivers engine the way O, MAA, GPT.AX and GMG.AX were. Routing: dcf-methods SKILL.md REIT row -- a REIT's reported FCF (OCF - development capex) and GAAP net income (FY2025 -$1,430M, Q3-2026 -$3.74/sh on $637.9M of impairments) do not mean what the owner-FCF engine assumes. ENGINE MAPPING: base_revenue = FY2026E total revenue; ebitda_margin_path = (FFO as adjusted + SBC) / revenue, i.e. a post-interest, post-NCI margin, NOT EBITDA; sbc_pct_path deducts SBC so the house flow equals FFO as adjusted; da_pct_path = 0 and cash_tax_rate_path = 0 (FFO already adds back real-estate D&A; REIT pays no entity-level tax); capex_pct_path = AFFO adjustments (recurring revenue- and non-revenue-enhancing capex, tenant improvements and leasing commissions, plus straight-line rent) as % of revenue; wc_capture_pct = 0; net_debt = 0; wacc = cost of equity. Development/redevelopment construction spend ($1.5-2.0B 2026) is NOT charged: it is treated as self-funded by the disposition program and leverage-neutral debt, and in return the growth paths are NET of disposition dilution rather than crediting the full delivered-NOI uplift -- growth is not free (CHC.AX/GMG.AX convention). FLOW BASE: FFOAsAdjustedPerShare from the kpis table is used, not FFOPerShare, which was inflated by a one-off ~$363M debt-extinguishment gain in Q1-2026 ($3.73 vs $1.73 as adjusted). TROUGH, NOT EXTRAPOLATED: the Q4-2026 exit run-rate (~$1.41/sh, implied by $6.40 FY guidance less $5.00 for 9M) is the starting point, and base FY2027 FFO of ~$5.60/sh sits BELOW the FY2026 print because 1.4M RSF of 2027 key expirations, the deferred $720M of dispositions, the hybrid-note coupon and lower capitalised interest all land in 2027; the base then recovers toward a mid-cycle ~45% FFO margin (FY2024 52% at 94.6% occupancy and $186M interest; FY2026E 41.5% at 87% and $280M). Realized gains on non-real-estate investments (~$65M 2026 guidance) are inside FFO as adjusted, so the venture book is in the flows and is NOT added as a bridge asset (matching-asset rule). Mid-cycle anchors: 10-year average occupancy ~95%; FY2023-24 occupancy 94.6%; same-store NOI +3-5% in 2023-24; Adjusted EBITDA margin 70-72% in 2024-25 vs 65% Q3-2026.

base.growth_note: FY2027 revenue falls: Q4-2026 exit run-rate (~$2,560M annualised) less the $720M of dispositions deferred into 2027 and 1.4M RSF of key expirations, partly offset by development deliveries and 90.8% occupancy incl. signed leases commencing. 2028+ growth = occupancy recovery (87% -> ~93% by 2031) plus ~3% escalators, net of continued capital recycling.
base.ebitda_margin_note: (FFO as adjusted + SBC) / revenue. FY2026E 43.0% (1,097 + 40 / 2,645); Q3-2026 run-rate 40.9%. FY2027 39.6% reflects negative same-store NOI (guided still negative in 2027), $30M+ of further possible wind-downs, the 7.25% hybrid coupon and lower capitalised interest. Mid-cycle 45% = Adjusted EBITDA margin ~69% less expensed interest ~13% of revenue less NCI share ~9% less G&A/other ~2%; FY2024 was 52% with $331M of interest capitalised.
base.capex_note: AFFO adjustments, not development capex: revenue- and non-revenue-enhancing capex (TI/LC on renewals, re-leasing and lease-up of vacant space) plus straight-line rent. FY2024 $273M = 8.8% of revenue at 94.6% occupancy; FY2025 $324M = 10.7%; FY2026E $510M = 19.3% as 1.2M RSF of expirations are re-leased. 2027 stays elevated for the 1.4M RSF of 2027 expirations (management: 2027 construction spend 'primarily' this category), then normalises to ~10% capex + ~2% straight-line rent.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: a 45% dividend cut has already been delivered, S&P has ARE on negative outlook at BBB+, management itself does not expect positive same-property NOI until after 2027, core-market lab vacancy is near 30%, and $1.0B of 7.25% hybrid capital signals real funding pressure (BXP precedent: 30% bear after one cut). Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things at once -- a biotech funding recovery, lower rates, and absorption of a supply wave that quintupled since 2021. Base 50%: the trough-then-recover path is anchored on management's 2027/2028 same-property commentary and the sequential Q3-2026 improvement (leasing 1.24M RSF, same-store NOI -6.7% vs -10.6% in Q2).

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
